identity.name: Netsh Helper DLL Registry Key Manipulation
identity.summary: An attacker modifies the netsh helper DLL registry keys to load a malicious DLL on system startup. Cortex detects this manipulation via registry changes and process execution.
identity.description: An attacker modifies the netsh helper DLL registry keys to load a malicious DLL on system startup. Cortex detects this manipulation via registry changes and process execution.

payload.code:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\netsh" /v "DllName" /t REG_EXPAND_SZ /d "C:\\temp\\malicious.dll" /f
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v "Shell" /t REG_SZ /d "C:\\temp\\malicious.dll" /f
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /v "Updater" /t REG_SZ /d "C:\\temp\\malicious.dll" /f

expected_artifacts.description: Registry key modification for netsh helper DLL
Execution of malicious DLL via netsh

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Netsh Helper DLL Registry Modification
biocs.description: Detection of registry key changes to netsh helper DLL paths
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY and event_sub_type = ENUM.REGISTRY_SET_VALUE
| filter action_file_path contains "HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\netsh"
| filter action_process_image_name = "reg.exe"

abiocs.name: Suspicious Netsh Process Execution
abiocs.description: Detection of netsh.exe executing a non-standard DLL via registry manipulation
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "netsh.exe"
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains "reg.exe"
abiocs.causality_anchor: registry modification of netsh helper DLL
